MAINTENANCE ADVICE

Recommended Care & Cleaning

Simple steps to maintain the appearance and longevity of your safety installations.

INVISIBLE GRILLS CARE

Caring for Stainless Steel Cables

Invisible grills require minimal upkeep. Periodic cleaning preserves cable clarity and prevents surface residue buildup.

  • ✓
    Dusting: Wipe cables occasionally with a dry microfibre cloth to remove airborne dust.
  • ✓
    Cleaning Solution: For heavier residue, use lukewarm water with a mild dish soap. Wipe down with clean water.
  • ✓
    Avoid Harsh Chemicals: Do not use bleach, hydrochloric acid, or steel wool on cables or aluminium profiles.
  • ✓
    Periodic Check: Inspect anchor tracks and fasteners periodically to verify secure placement.
Explore Invisible Grills →
SAFETY NETS CARE

Caring for Balcony Safety Nets

Safety nets are designed to withstand regular outdoor weather conditions. Simple maintenance preserves mesh alignment.

  • ✓
    Visual Inspection: Check corner hooks and perimeter boundary ropes every 6 to 12 months.
  • ✓
    Rinsing: Clean dust using a gentle water spray from a garden hose or wet cloth.
  • ✓
    Avoid Sharp Objects: Keep sharp tools and direct heat sources away from nylon netting mesh.
  • ✓
    Service Request: If a net requires re-hooking after severe weather or balcony renovation, contact our team.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Service & Care Questions

Straightforward, practical information about invisible grill installation, balcony safety, and building society approvals.

Will the wires rust or discolour over time? +
Our invisible grills use stainless steel cables encased in a protective coating designed for outdoor residential balconies and weathering resistance. The outer casing additionally shields the stainless steel core against airborne dust and moisture.
What warranty do you offer on invisible grills and safety nets? +
